Elena / team — quick notes from the infra side after reviewing the sample traces: 

- Recommended config for evaluation/early production: 4x A10G (dedicated) with 32GB KV cache, continuous batching set to 20ms target for low-latency threads. This keeps p95 under 420ms in our tests.
- Quantization profile: q4_0 maintains accuracy on your prompts; q2 leads to a small increase in hallucination rate.
- I’ll add a short "Infra appendix" to the SOW with the exact CPU/GPU and networking requirements.

Proposed plan for the exec readout: 1) 5-min context recap (Hannah), 2) 10-min trial metrics and infra readout (Marcus), 3) 10-min commercial terms & SOW (Hannah/Monica), 4) 10-min Q&A and decision.

I’ve attached the SOW draft with infra appendix — redwood-sow-draft.docx. If procurement can confirm Lina's availability, we can lock Jul 13 at 15:00 PT for the readout.
